encrypted.zip.note: General-purpose flag bit 0 set. Pins the password-protected rejection branch.

highratio.zip.note: 1 MiB of one repeated byte, DEFLATE compressed (~1000:1). Documents that no RATIO ceiling exists today — E1/PR-3 changes this.

project.tar.note: Same logical tree as project.zip, TAR/ustar encoded.

project.tar.gz.note: Gzipped project.tar — exercises the gunzip ratio guard and the tar-inside-gzip fallback.

project.zip.note: Source tree + node_modules + .git + nested .pptx + a ../ traversal entry.

sample.docx.note: Three paragraphs including unicode and an entity.

sample.epub.note: container.xml → OPF; two spine chapters plus a non-XHTML spine item that must be skipped.

sample.odt.note: content.xml + meta.xml with dc:title; entity, unicode and a line-break.

sample.pptx.note: 10 numbered slides (10-vs-2 ordering), entity-encoded runs, one text-free slide, one notes slide that must be ignored.

sample.xlsx.note: Three sheets. Comma-in-value, leading-zero string, decimal, unicode, XML entity, gap column, skipped row, empty sheet.
